host.orchestration_affinity: CPU 0; other Codex processes excluded from CPUs 13 and 29

artifacts.timed_and_final_difference: ELF build identity, attestation text, and symbol-table offsets only; .text, .rodata, and .data match byte-for-byte.

implementation.receive_boundary: Load public bytes 0..126 directly, synthesize byte 127 as zero, and fuse the first two inverse LCH layers into 128-byte work rows.
implementation.one_shot_setup: Store bounded Algorithm 5 erasure metadata in caller scratch rather than allocating a transient vector-owned decode plan.
implementation.output_boundary: Write complete transform output to scratch and copy only bytes 0..126 to each public restored shard.
implementation.fallback: Every other byte/count/loss/backend/profile combination retains the established reusable-plan or general one-shot route.

tail_loads: 16 bytes at source+96, covering public bytes 96..111
16 bytes at source+111, covering public bytes 111..126; shift right by one byte to form bytes 112..126 plus zero
source_boundary_safety.assembly_observation: The exact-tail cases load XMM vectors only at offsets 0x60 and 0x6f. No load starts at or includes source+127.
source_boundary_safety.asan_boundary: API tests allocate exact 127-byte shard vectors; both R-1 and R one-shot cases pass Clang 18 ASan+UBSan, so a source[127] read or 128-byte public output write would hit a redzone.

common.pinning: Each benchmark process pinned to CPU 13; CPU 29 continuously monitored for runnable tasks.
common.order: Counterbalanced ABBA process order with identical deterministic seeds and missing-coordinate patterns.
common.ratio_semantics: Ratios above one mean the candidate in the denominator is faster.

fused_screen.comparison: fixed 127-to-128 staging copy versus fused direct source boundary

raw_abba.comparison: same source and identical .text/.rodata; a single diagnostic data word disables or enables scratch-owned raw one-shot setup

full_exact_main_map.main_semantics: Exact Leopard main processes a physical 128-byte shard and fingerprints only the zero-padded 127-byte logical prefix.
full_exact_main_map.purpose: Exhaustive directional crossover map; the weak-cell rerun supplies confidence intervals.

weak_rerun.interval: Deterministic percentile bootstrap over eight round-level ABBA ratios.

neighbors.comparison: final enabled binary versus same-source disabled-control binary

correctness.release_focused: 5/5 passed in 4.77 seconds: context_backends, api, random, decode_plan_schedule, high_pruned_legacy
correctness.clang18_asan_ubsan_api: 1/1 passed in 1.66 seconds with 16 MiB ASan quarantine; includes R-1 and R exact-127 one-shot boundaries
correctness.field_builds: FF8-only and FF16-only production libraries compile
correctness.strict_clang_changed_translation_units: leopard2.cpp, LeopardFF8.cpp, and Leopard2BackendAVX2.cpp compile with Clang 18 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror
correctness.strict_clang_full_target: A pre-existing option-dependent unused-helper failure in Leopard2BackendAVX2T8K8B1024.cpp is tracked separately as leopard-79h.40.19.8.

decision.reason: The direct exact-source boundary removes the remaining staging pass, scratch-owned raw setup removes transient plan allocation, all 2048 exact-main cells win, all weak-cell confidence intervals remain above parity, neighbor regressions stay below two percent, and exact-byte sanitizer boundaries are clean.
decision.measured_region: GF8 AVX2 legacy-high N=128/T=32, K=33..96, R=17..32, B=127, and R-1 or R missing originals.
decision.non_claim: This evidence does not generalize the exact-source kernel to other byte lengths, transform sides, fields, backends, or lower loss counts.
